text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Fngyaaaaah!? A-A-A giant lizard~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Sorry to startle you. I found 
this little one wandering outside and took 
it in.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're keeping it here? Aren't pets 
banned in the dorms?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I got special permission under the 
pretense of fostering it. Though it's on 
the condition that it's only until someone 
from the animal welfare center comes to 
pick it up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I have to take good care of it until that 
day comes. Let's start by feeding it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, your favorite fish! Open 
wide!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ooh, it ate it! Me next! Let me feed it~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Here, say aaaaaah—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...They're totally not eating it! 
Heart-chan, show them how it's done 
again~♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Got it? You move it like this to make it 
look fresh~~ ...See!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
"Heart~! You have training off today, 
right? Let's all go to the family 
restaurant~."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! I've got someone waiting for me 
to come home♪

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that the lizard everyone's talking 
about? You're totally doting on it!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"From its eyes to its scales, it's just so 
cute all over! Come see it next time!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-cha~n! Hey, hey, looks like a 
package came for ya!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that box way too huge?! What's 
even inside it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A complete lizard breeding set! Now they 
can live even more comfortably♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to move~. You get to go 
into a bigger cage now!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? You look down. You're kinda pale 
too! Are you sick or something!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! It's just before my molt! My 
movement gets sluggish at this timing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Shedding her shell like this and growing 
up... I can't wait to see it!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I see! Well then, let's go for a walk once 
you're bigger!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but that means we'd have to say 
goodbye then, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Come on! Keep your chin up! Now while 
they're quiet is our chance to move!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Lizard-bro, quit thrashing around! You're 
not being gentle at all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! Don't knock over the water bowl! 
...Fufu, jeez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amid the busy days of caring for it, the 
day finally arrived for the lizard to be 
picked upâ

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Then, I will take full responsibility for 
watching over it until we find the next 
owner. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Uwahh...! Bye-byyyye! Take careee~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! They leftttt~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: It was like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, dreams must eventually come to an 
end. Time to get back to our everyday 
lives!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, why don't we go to a family restaurant 
on our next day off? You've been so busy 
lately, we haven't been able to go!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *sniff*... I'm coming~~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Did you see the new lipstick?! Isn't that 
color super cute?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Pandora seems fine now... The real 
problem is—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...I talked big back there, but... Hehe, 
I'm hopeless.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I should've said it properly. ...Said 
"Bye-bye."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went up to the rooftop for 
a change of pace...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer. Sorry, I just got some dust 
in my eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had heard rumors that Daring Heart let 
go of her beloved lizard... I wonder if 
she's feeling down after all...
choice_data_list: Umm, should I go buy us some drinks?

I hope the little one I used to keep is 
doing well!

I hope the little one you used to keep is 
doing well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had heard rumors that Daring Heart let 
go of her beloved lizard... I wonder if 
she's feeling down after all...
choice_data_list: Umm, should I go buy us some drinks?

I hope the little one I used to keep is 
doing well!

I hope the little one you used to keep is 
doing well!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's go to a cafe! You go 
on ahead, I'll catch up right away!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry about that. I handed 
over a note detailing that child's quirks. 
Anyone who looks after them will be just 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When the day comes that we can meet again, 
she'll show us how well she's doing. Until 
that day—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: See you again! ...Just like that!
